title: 族譜往上找
question:
族譜是一棵樹：每個人只有一個爸爸或媽媽在上一層。家族裡的人編號 0 到 n - 1，0 號是阿祖（第 1 代），他上面沒有人，記成 -1。
第一行輸入有幾個人，第二行依序輸入 0 號、1 號……每個人的上一代是幾號，第三行輸入要查的人。從他開始一路往上走到阿祖，把經過的人一行一個輸出，最後輸出他是「第 幾 代」。

en.title: Family Tree
en.question:
A family tree is a tree: each person has one parent in the level above. The people are numbered 0 to n - 1. Number 0 is the great-grandparent (generation 1), with no one above, written as -1.
The first line is how many people. The second line is the parent of person 0, 1, ... in order. The third line is the person to look up. Go up from that person to number 0, output each person on the way, one per line, then output 第 n 代 (the generation).
